tasks.description: Build a transactional event-sourced inventory engine with concurrency, idempotency, replay, and tamper detection

results.description: Build a transactional event-sourced inventory engine with concurrency, idempotency, replay, and tamper detection

metrics.finalText:
Implemented a complete production-quality event-sourced inventory engine with:

- **Domain behavior** (`src/engine.ts`): InventoryEngine with execute, executeBatch (atomic rollback), state, history, exportLog, and static fromLog. Full command lifecycle: create-sku, receive, reserve, release, ship.
- **Event log storage** (`src/store.ts`): Deterministic SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL export with manifest, rigorous validation (positions, hash chain, manifest, tamper detection), and event replay.
- **Types & errors** (`src/types.ts`): All public interfaces, discriminated unions, custom ConcurrencyError and ValidationError.
- **Public facade** (`src/index.ts`): Exports all API surface.
- **33 additional tests** (`test/inventory.test.ts`): Input validation, concurrency, idempotency, reservation invariants, deep immutability, export/import round-trip, log tamper detection, batch atomicity, multi-SKU operations, and edge cases.

All 36 tests pass (3 contract + 33 additional). Typecheck clean. Original files preserved. Only Node built-ins used.
